starwars-sd.aviso.semSpaceDragon: Star Wars SD: the Space Dragon module is disabled. This supplement's classes and powers use its rules — enable it in Manage Modules.
starwars-sd.settings.regrasDeNave.dica: Sets the table's DEFAULT rule, used by every new ship. Tactical: the Supplement's tactical combat, with a maneuver dial, secretly planned maneuvers, Overload and defence dice that cancel damage dice. Book: Space Dragon §10.6, with no grid and no dial — defence is the CP, and only small ships trade the CP for a saving throw via evasive maneuvers. Any single ship can use the other rule via Configure Sheet, with no reload.
starwars-sd.settings.temaDaNave.dica: The ship sheet has its own palette and does not follow a dark-mode module on its own. On automatic it follows the page (the theme-dark class, used by Foundry and by most such modules) and, failing that, the operating system preference. A per-viewer preference: it applies only to you.
starwars-sd.settings.movimentoDaNave.dic: Hex: as the Supplement writes it — the ship moves straight through the cells and turns at the end. Arc: the X-Wing Miniatures Game mechanic — it follows the curve, turning along it, and stops where it would bump instead of skipping cells. Not just looks: the final position changes.
starwars-sd.settings.camadaEnergia.dica: Adds the Power panel to the ship sheet. The reactor grants points per round (2 to 6, by size) that Engineering splits between Engines, Shields and Weapons. It is the layer with the best return per round; if you enable only one, enable this.
starwars-sd.settings.camadaAvarias.dica: Gives critical damage a deadline: propulsion has 3 rounds, weapons and sensors 2. Fixing it costs the action of whoever is in that chamber; missing the deadline leaves the chamber inoperative until a dockyard repair. This is what gives the unstationed PC something to do.
starwars-sd.settings.camadaFuga.dica: Adds the pursuer's clock beside the three jump steps. It advances one mark per round, and two when the ship takes new critical damage or chooses Run. Whoever fills it first decides the scene — on a tie, the pursuer catches up.
starwars-sd.settings.temaDoLivro.dica: Swaps the colours of Old Dragon 2 sheets for this setting's book palette — parchment in light mode, deep space in dark, and the Tactical green for interactive elements. REQUIRES “Space Dragon theme on sheets” to be enabled in the Space Dragon module settings: its stylesheet is what overrides the system's selectors, and this layer only swaps the colours. Off by default, because in a mixed world one setting's palette on another's sheet is a bug, not a style.
starwars-sd.settings.ordemDeAcao.dica: INVERTS the combat tracker order so the LOWEST value acts first, as the book's Order of Action requires (§7.5 and §10.6), and whispers the round duration to the GM on every turn — twice the highest value, in seconds. Declaring itself (picking the action and rolling the value) lives in the attacks tab, provided by the Space Dragon module; the ship sheet uses the rule in both modes. This applies to EVERY combat in the world: enable it only if the whole table uses this rule.
